But if, in addition, the trip is not local (no travel), it is rejected after all. However, in that case, if the claimant is a contractor, it is reimbursed.
Rule 3 (training courses): training courses items are reimbursed by default. Exception: if a receipt is attached, it is rejected instead. However, in that case, if the claimant is a part-time employee, it is reimbursed. Even then, if there were at most 7 attendees, it is rejected. But if, in addition, it was submitted more than 46 days after purchase, it is reimbursed after all.
Rule 4 (software): software items are rejected by default. Exception: if the claimant is a full-time employee, it is reimbursed instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if there were more than 18 attendees, it is rejected. Even then, if it was submitted within 31 days of purchase, it is reimbursed. Rule 1 (electrical surge): electrical surge items are covered by default. Exception: if there are at most 2 prior claims in the last 3 years, it is denied instead. But if, in addition, the incident was reported more than 31 days after it happened, it is covered after all. Even then, if the claimed loss is at most $28000, it is denied.
Rule 2 (flood): flood items are covered by default. Exception: if the property is in a mountain region, it is denied instead. Even then, if the policy tier is not premium, it is covered. But if, in addition, the incident was reported within 6 days of it happening, it is denied after all.
Rule 3 (mold): mold items are covered by default. Exception: if no monitored alarm was installed, it is denied instead. Even then, if the home was vacant at the time, it is covered. However, in that case, if no police report was filed, it is denied.

- Claim 3 (category: mold) - monitored alarm installed: no; police report filed: no; home vacant at time of incident: no; maintenance records provided: yes.

HOME INSURANCE CLAIMS POLICY
Each claim is decided by the rule for its category. Within a rule, every exception clause is only considered if the clause immediately before it applied; when an exception applies, its decision replaces the previous one.

Rule 1 (windstorm): windstorm items are denied by default. Exception: if the home was occupied at the time, it is covered instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if the home is at most 56 years old, it is denied. But if, in addition, the policy tier is standard, it is covered after all. Further exception to the previous clause: if the claimed loss is over $33500, it is denied.
Rule 2 (water damage): water damage items are denied by default. Exception: if the policy tier is not standard, it is covered instead. But if, in addition, the home was vacant at the time, it is denied after all. However, in that case, if the claimed loss is at most $35000, it is covered. But if, in addition, there are at most 2 prior claims in the last 3 years, it is denied after all.
Rule 3 (theft): theft items are covered by default. Exception: if the policy tier is basic, it is denied instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if the claimed loss is at most $43000, it is covered. But if, in addition, a monitored alarm was installed, it is denied after all. Even then, if the incident was reported within 29 days of it happening, it is covered.
Rule 4 (fire): fire items are covered by default. Exception: if a monitored alarm was installed, it is denied instead. However, in that case, if the damage was assessed by an agent, it is covered. Further exception to the previous clause: if the home was occupied at the time, it is denied. Even then, if the claimed loss is at most $16000, it is covered.

CASE
- Claim 1 (category: water damage) - claimed loss: $35000; days before incident was reported: 6 days; monitored alarm installed: no; home vacant at time of incident: no; prior claims in last 3 years: 1; policy tier: platinum.
- Claim 2 (category: windstorm) - home age: 54 years; policy tier: basic; claimed loss: $36500; maintenance records provided: no; property region: mountain; home vacant at time of incident: no.
- Claim 3 (category: fire) - home vacant at time of incident: no; monitored alarm installed: yes; prior claims in last 3 years: 2; claimed loss: $19000; damage assessed by: an agent; policy tier: premium.

Each request is decided by the rule for its category. Within a rule, every exception clause is only considered if the clause immediately before it applied; when an exception applies, its decision replaces the previous one.

Rule 1 (executive floor): executive floor items are granted by default. Exception: if the person has more than 4 open security incidents, it is denied instead. Even then, if the entry date is not a public holiday, it is granted. But if, in addition, the person has been with the organization for at most 12 months, it is denied after all. Even then, if the person is escorted by a facilities manager, it is granted.
Rule 2 (data center cage): data center cage items are granted by default. Exception: if the person is an employee, it is denied instead. Even then, if the badge clearance is at most level 3, it is granted. However, in that case, if entry is requested at or before 15:00, it is denied. Further exception to the previous clause: if the person has been with the organization for at most 15 months, it is granted.
Rule 3 (server room): server room items are granted by default. Exception: if the person is not an employee, it is denied instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if the badge clearance is above level 4, it is granted. Even then, if the person has been with the organization for at most 5 months, it is denied. However, in that case, if the biometric check did not pass, it is granted.

- Request 3 (category: data center cage) - person type: an employee; months with the organization: 9 months; requested entry time: 12:00; badge clearance level: level 3; open security incidents: 0; on a public holiday: no.

Rule 1 (software): software items are rejected by default. Exception: if the claimant is an intern, it is reimbursed instead. Rule 2 (taxi): taxi items are rejected by default. Exception: if it was not paid with the corporate card, it is reimbursed instead. Even then, if it was paid in GBP, it is rejected. Even then, if it was submitted more than 17 days after purchase, it is reimbursed. Further exception to the previous clause: if there were at most 16 attendees, it is rejected.
Rule 3 (meals): meals items are rejected by default. Exception: if a receipt is attached, it is reimbursed instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if it was pre-approved by a VP, it is rejected. Even then, if the claimant is a part-time employee, it is reimbursed. Even then, if the vendor is on the preferred list, it is rejected.
Rule 4 (equipment): equipment items are rejected by default. Exception: if the trip is local (no travel), it is reimbursed instead. However, in that case, if a receipt is attached, it is rejected. Further exception to the previous clause: if it was paid in EUR, it is reimbursed. Further exception to the previous clause: if it was incurred on a weekend, it is rejected.
